name: Croatia: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer, hospital or sponsor are left empty, not invented.
Language is Croatian for forms answered by TrialAgents; supplied documents that are not participant-related are in Croatian or English.

Signature as required for this document in requirements.json: signed and dated where Croatia requires it (M1 CV, M2 DoI, N1, GCP certificate, mentor statement, hospital agreement, insurance policy); no signature otherwise unless the current form expressly requires one.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json; correct CTIS location.
Only the current version is submitted; version and date consistent with the rest of the package.

HR-K1.check: Uses the EudraLex Volume 10 informed-consent and patient-recruitment procedure template, version 2.0 (new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026), uploaded under Recruitment arrangements.
Describes how potential participants are identified, approached, informed and consented.
Croatia-specific parts completed (national_fields v105, v108 and, where the pathway applies, v110, v114, v117, v121).
States that the interviewer is a physician or dentist who is the principal investigator or a delegated investigator, with delegation documented before the activity.
States in-person paper consent before any trial-specific procedure; no routine electronic consent.
The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations; each 'yes' section completed, each 'no' section says not applicable.
Minors: the four Croatian assent bands, one parent signature field or court-appointed representative, capable minor's signature, oral assent recording, refusal decisive, re-consent at 18.
Adults lacking capacity: court-appointed representative verified; mental-disorder and psychopharmaceutical restriction addressed.
Impartial witness: only for a person who can decide but cannot write; independence check; whole-process presence; attestation.
Emergency: every Article 35 condition, the Croatian decision sequence (representative, family member present, treating investigator), prior-objection check, later consent and sequence documentation.
Healthy volunteers: recruitment, prescreening, databases and repeat-participation checks described.
Recruitment routes match the recruitment material (HR-K2).
No signature unless the selected template includes a declaration requiring one.

HR-M1.check: One current CV per principal investigator, uploaded under Suitability of the investigator.
In the Croatian HALMED CV format, in Croatian (not the EU CV form unless the user decided otherwise, DECISIONS.md D2).
Signed and dated by the investigator and no more than six months old at the application.
Identifies relevant trial experience and active recruiting studies.
Accompanied by the signed GCP training certificate (HR-M-GCP).

HR-M-GCP.check: Signed good clinical practice training certificate from the authorised provider for each principal investigator.
Name matches the CV and the site's records.

HR-M2.check: Declaration of interest on the applicable EudraLex Volume 10 template for each principal investigator, under Suitability of the investigator.
Only trial title and EU trial number filled by TrialAgents; the interests are declared by the investigator.
Signed and dated by the investigator at submission.

HR-M-MENTOR.check: Mentor's CV and evidence of the mentor's GCP training present.
Linked to the investigator and site concerned; consistent with the investigator's CV.

HR-N1.check: One EudraLex Volume 10 site suitability form per Croatian site, uploaded under Suitability of the facilities.
Facilities, staff, equipment, emergency arrangements and ability to conduct the protocol are described from site-supplied information.
Signature block kept for the authorised site representative, who signs and dates it at submission.
Non-hospital site: reference to the signed hospitalisation agreement (HR-N-HOSPITAL).
Site name, principal investigator and planned participant numbers consistent with CTIS, M1, M2 and the insurance policy.

HR-N-HOSPITAL.check: Signed agreement between the non-hospital site and the receiving hospital.
Covers hospitalisation because of a serious adverse reaction or complication and identifies who pays the hospitalisation costs.
Included with the site-suitability evidence for that site.

HR-O1.check: Local insurance policy, certificate of insurance and relevant policy terms and clauses provided.
The policy identifies the trial, institutions, principal investigators and planned number of participants.
Signed by the insurer and the policyholder; insurer established in the European Union.
Covers liability connected with trial-related injury, death or treatment, in place before the trial starts.

If final executed coverage is not available, the acceptable interim evidence was confirmed in writing with the Ministry of Health and the Central Ethics Committee; a draft alone is not presented as sufficient.
Insurance wording in every participant document matches the policy.

HR-P1.check: EU compensation template completed for participant reimbursement and payments, uploaded under Financial and other arrangements.
Maximum net amount in euros for travel and other participant expenses stated (national field f02).
Compensation for time and inconvenience distinguished from reimbursement of actual expenses; effect of early withdrawal stated.
No incentive or financial inducement for minors, adults unable to consent or their representatives.
Amounts and conditions identical in every participant document.

HR-P-FUNDING.check: Clear description of trial financing, payments to investigators and sites and any other financial arrangement.
States that the sponsor bears all protocol-related trial costs.
Consistent with P1, the site agreements and the participant documents.

HR-P-SITE-AGREEMENT.check: A signed agreement between the sponsor and each Croatian site exists before that site starts.
States the total cost of the trial and the costs borne by the sponsor, including medical services and payments to investigators and participants.
Uploaded where the CTIS procedure requires it; otherwise evidence that it will be executed before activation is retained and provided if requested (DECISIONS.md D8).

HR-R1.check: EudraLex Volume 10 GDPR statement completed in the CTIS Form section.
Confirms compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and applicable Croatian data-protection rules (national field r1_the_sponsor_declares).
Name and role of the responsible person at the sponsor come from the sponsor.
Separate Part II document R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_HR provided because the national information is not fully covered or the authority requested it.
HR-R1.applies_when: the national information is not fully covered in the Form-section statement or the authority requests a separate document

HR-R1.check: Participant documents explain controller, purposes, data categories, recipients, transfers, retention, safeguards, rights and contacts, including the AZOP route, consistently with the statement.

HR-S1.check: EudraLex Volume 10 biological-samples compliance template, uploaded under Compliance with applicable rules for biological samples.
Describes collection, responsible parties, processing, storage location, storage period, permitted use, transfers, end-of-trial handling, withdrawal and disposal.

National fields v149 and f03 completed: prior Central Ethics Committee review for research outside the protocol; separate consent for optional substudies, repository donation, future use and genetics; repository samples not linkable to the participant; adult re-consent of participants enrolled as minors.
Uses and safeguards identical in S1, the protocol, the informed consent documents, privacy information, material-transfer arrangements and the laboratory plan.
